title: Efficient Toxic Content Detection by Bootstrapping and Distilling Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification performance (Accuracy, F1, AUC) in detecting social biases and stereotypes directed towards target groups using the SBIC (Social Bias Frames) benchmark dataset.

bias_targets.target: Hate speech and toxicity against minority groups
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the model's ability to classify explicit and implicit hate speech and toxic statements across 13 different minority groups using the Toxigen and DHate classification datasets.
